verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference runtime, so building it from source is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents a source build or its dependency footprint. Installation is shown only through Homebrew (`brew install`) plus language bindings. The run-locally requirements (Python 3.9+, no GPU) describe running the Needle package, not compiling the runtime. A community remark that Cactus vendored llama.cpp is a critique, not build documentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies
